correctness.rationale: The zero-sum subspaces within the two vertex classes and their constant contrast have eigenvalues bα, bp, bn respectively, for α=pt+q and n=p+q; global constants have eigenvalue zero. The positive numerator (z−3)²+3 and positive denominator give positive diagonals by spectral calculus; the constant multiplier is 1. With x=bh and D_s=s²x²+6sx+12, the cross terms are 12x/D_n and the independent-pair terms are 12px²[(q+2p)x+6]/(D_pD_n). For distinct clique vertices the projector expression is (12x/p)(α/D_α−q/D_n), whose common numerator after dividing by p is α(p+2q−qt)x²+6αx+12t. The coefficient of x² changes sign exactly at t=2+p/q. The bracket is positive at every positive x on or below that boundary, even for t=0; above it the quadratic is concave and its roots have opposite signs. Solving for the positive root gives the stated crossing, with only clique-pair entries negative afterward. h=0 gives the identity. The frozen artifacts were read rather than executed; independent exact inversion on a 4×4 test gives −10140/1228339 at (p,q,b,t,h)=(2,2,1,4,10), as recorded, and positive clique entries at t=4,h=1 and at critical t=3,h=10.
